name: Wakamaru
summary: A yellow, one-meter home companion robot with a humanoid torso and arms on a wheeled base, sold by Mitsubishi Heavy Industries from 2005 for around ¥1.5 million. Wakamaru recognized faces, understood about 10,000 everyday words, reminded people of appointments and could call for help — an early, commercial attempt at a domestic social robot.
notable: Face recognition and a 10,000-word conversational vocabulary
